Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer's analysis incorrectly concluded that Constantine Palaiologos's maternal grandmother was Maria Laskarina. The WebSurfer's own search results in that same turn explicitly stated that "Anna of Hungary (Byzantine empress)... was the daughter of Stephen V of Hungary and Elizabeth the Cuman." However, the agent ignored this direct evidence and relied on a previous search (from Step 3) that was about a different Anna of Hungary (Anna of Hungary, Duchess of Macsó, daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina). The agent failed to distinguish between two different historical figures named "Anna of Hungary," leading to the wrong identification of the maternal grandmother (Maria Laskarina instead of Elizabeth the Cuman).
